thread:
Anna: Pushed new frames for the 'mute' flow in the SLO editor. Trying 'Mute for 1h' vs 'Snooze for 1h' copy. Figmap review: https://figma.com/file/efgh5678 :point_up_2:
Ben: Saw it. I worry 'Snooze' reads like a local browser action (like snoozing a tab). 'Mute' is more about notifications.
Maya: +1 on 'Mute'. Also we need explicit microcopy: 'Muted alerts will not send notifications but will still create incidents.' Users keep expecting alerts to disappear entirely.
Anna: Good call. Where to surface that microcopy without cluttering the compact row?
Carlos: Could be a single-line caption below the control (12px). On hover/tap we can show expanded explanation. Avoid putting it inside the main CTA.
Kai: Accessibility: ensure the control is keyboard-operable and announces state changes. Use aria-pressed for toggle or role=switch with aria-checked. Example: <button role="switch" aria-checked="true" aria-label="Mute notifications for 1 hour">Mute</button>. Also add aria-live="polite" on the status region.
Anna: Nice. I used a pill in the mock. Do we prefer switch vs pill for affordance consistency?
Ben: Switch is better for boolean. Pills feel like actions with duration.
Maya: Another copy nit: for the preview modal header we currently show 'Notification preview'. Change to 'Who gets notified' 13 makes intent clearer.
Carlos: On long channel names the grid collapses. We should use truncation + tooltip with full name. Tooltip must appear on hover and focus.
Kai: Tooltip must have role=tooltip and be focusable. For hover-only tooltips add onfocus handler to show it for keyboard users. Also ensure contrast of tooltip background meets 4.5:1 when text is small.
Anna: Will update mocks: switch control, caption text, 'Who gets notified' header, ellipsis + tooltip. Will add aria changes.
deploy-bot: Reminder: design tokens v2 released yesterday; focus-outline token changed. See #eng-design-tokens for migration notes.
Ben: One more UX ask: when using duration presets (1h / 6h / 24h), indicate which preset is selected with both color and an outline so colorblind users can tell.
Maya: Also add an inline 'Custom...' option that opens a small input with examples like '2 hours', '90m'. Keep placeholder example text.
Anna: Great. I'll push updated frames with those changes and add a short annotation list for engineers describing aria attributes and tooltip behavior. Back with updates by EOD. :thumbsup:
Kai: Quick follow-up when you push: include the aria-labels exactly in the annotation so we don't get inventing variations during implementation.
Anna: Will do. Thanks all.
Carlos: Thanks! I'll sanity-check long names against recent customer channel lists.
